answer: Sybils drown when trust flows like a tide instead of being granted once: a newcomer earns standing only through a chain of signed endorsements, each endorser staking reputation with a quill signature that cannot be erased. A willow branch bends but stays rooted — likewise, an identity that keeps producing verifiable work across changing tides of demand stays trusted, while a thousand fresh cuttings with no roots and no endorsers simply wash away.
